text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Yonge Street, City Council approval of this report is required. The purpose of this report is to respond to City Council's direction to review and report back on the realignment of Permit Parking Area 5H to exclude the development located at 1080-1088 Yonge Street. Staff have determined the realignment of the Permit Parking Area 5H is feasible and has no objections to excluding the development located at 1080-1088 Yonge Street. If City Council excludes this address from the subject Permit Parking Area, residents and visitors of this address will be prohibited from participating in the on-street permit parking program.

City Council on December 13, 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Schedule B of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate a revised map of Permit Parking Area 5H as shown in Attachment 1 to the report (October 30, 2023) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services, excluding the development currently located at 1080-1088 Yonge Street.
